how: Two resident agents started within eight seconds of each other at 19:55:55 UTC on an ordinary Windows desktop against the nine published servers, thirty-two second cadence, 250 ms ceiling, each asked for a reading with timewitness stamp --agent --no-evidence: one every five seconds for forty minutes and one every ten seconds for seven minutes. The raw readings, the receipts taken at thirty-six minutes and their verify output are on the desktop that took them, beside the raw readings.
what: Uptime marks of the two agents: the last refusal at 102 s on the forty-minute run and 101 s on the seven-minute run; on the forty-minute run a signature at 3 s, refusals from 9 s to 37 s, a signature at 43 s, refusals from 48 s to 67 s; and the ten second interval between readings on the seven-minute run
